blocks.text: "So if you turn away, still I have conveyed the Message with which I was sent to you. My Lord will make another people succeed you, and you will not harm Him in the least. Surely, my Lord is Guardian over all things."
Verily We: It is We Who have sent down the Dhikr (i.e. the Quran) and surely, We will guard it (from corruption).
These two great Names point to Allaah being described as protecting. Allaah's protection for His servants is of two types: general and specific.

The General Protection is His protection for them by facilitating their food, drink and air. It is also guiding them to that which will benefit them and to what He has decreed and ordained for them of the necessities and needs. This is general guidance about which Allaah said,
[Musa (Moses)] said: "Our Lord is He Who gave to each thing its form and nature, then guided it aright."

He protects them by repelling different types of disliked things, harms and evils from them. This protection is shared for the good person and the corrupt one and even the animals and other than them. Angels are appointed over humankind to protect them by Allaah's command as He says,
For each (person), there are angels in succession, before and behind him. They guard him by the Command of Allah.
This means that they repel all that will harm them by Allaah's command which if it did reach them would harm them if it were not for Allaah's protection.

The Specific Protection is His protection for those of His allies who are close to Him. This is in addition to the previous general protection. He protects their faith from deviant doubts, devastating trials and destructive desires. He saves them from this. He protects them from their enemies of jinn and mankind.
He helps them against them and repels the schemes and plots of the enemies as He says,
Truly, Allah defends those who believe. Verily! Allah likes not any treacherous ingrate to Allah [those who disobey Allah but obey Shaitan (Satan)].
Allaah defends the servants according to the level of their faith.
Due to this the Prophet ﷺ said in his advice to Ibn 'Abbaas,
"Be mindful of Allah and He will protect you".

This means preserve Allaah's commands by doing them: His prohibitions by avoiding them and His limits by not overstepping them and Allaah will protect you in your body, your religion, your wealth, your children and in everything that Allaah has given you.

keyPoints: Al-Hafeedh and Al-Haafidh point to Allaah being described as protecting.
Allaah's protection for His servants is of two types: general and specific.

General protection: facilitating food, drink and air, guiding them to what benefits them, and repelling harms and evils; it is shared by the good and the corrupt and even the animals, and angels are appointed to guard humankind (Ra'd 13:11).
Specific protection is for His close allies: He protects their faith from deviant doubts, devastating trials and destructive desires, and protects them from their enemies of jinn and mankind.
Allaah defends the servants according to the level of their faith, as in the hadeeth "Be mindful of Allah and He will protect you".

evidence.text: Surely, my Lord is Guardian over all things.
Be mindful of Allah and He will protect you.

recall.q: What do the Names Al-Hafeedh (The Guardian and Preserver) and Al-Haafidh (The Protector) point to?
What are the two types of Allaah's protection for His servants?
recall.a: General protection (food, drink, air, guidance to what benefits them, repelling harms, shared by all including animals) and specific protection for His close allies (protecting their faith from doubts, trials and desires, and protecting them from their enemies).

recall.q: Which aayah does the author cite about the angels who guard each person?
recall.a: Ra'd 13:11: 'For each (person), there are angels in succession, before and behind him. They guard him by the Command of Allah.'

recall.q: What advice did the Prophet ﷺ give Ibn 'Abbaas related to this Name, and what does it mean?
recall.a: "Be mindful of Allah and He will protect you": preserve Allaah's commands by doing them, His prohibitions by avoiding them and His limits by not overstepping them, and He will protect you in your body, religion, wealth, children and all He has given you.

recall.q: According to what does Allaah defend His servants?
recall.a: According to the level of their faith.
